explanation.definitionFit: The 1941 Atlantic Charter was a joint statement of war aims signed by Roosevelt and Churchill, a famous pact between nations.

clue.text: Corrupt cockney isn''t connected with Edward

clue.text: One to gather whilst ye may!

explanation.definitionFit: Herrick's famous verse urges young people to pick these unopened flowers before time passes, so one is the thing to gather.

clue.text: Reverse a fight advantage

clue.text: One is long-suffering to go in thus

clue.text: A shipshape city?

clue.text: Theorem unexplored, featuring a bird

clue.text: Appearance of space

clue.text: Too much Bovril led partly to being unwell
